user.title: Add Intercom Manager
user.description: Creates an empty, removable manager with silence controls and a panel. Choose explicit users and trusted HTTPS origins, then configure rooms and permissions in Intercom Manager.

error.invalid_origin: Enter at least one origin as an HTTPS origin without a path, query, credentials, or fragment.
error.invalid_users: Choose at least one active, non-system Home Assistant user.
error.invalid_room_name: Enter a room name from 1 to 64 characters without control characters.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Intercom Manager entry is allowed.

abort.manage_rooms: Manage rooms in the Intercom Manager sidebar panel.
abort.deployment_unavailable: Speaker deployment is unavailable. Existing room controls remain available in Intercom Manager.
abort.no_speakers: No speaker connections are configured. Choose Add a speaker connection first.
abort.deployment_changed: Speaker configuration changed during this form. Open Configure again to use the current version.
abort.speaker_connection_saved: Speaker connection saved privately. Open Speakers in Intercom Manager to check the connection and prepare installation. No speaker changes were made.

speaker.title: Private speaker connection
speaker.description: For the supported Third Reality 3RAB01090D speaker. Enter its private IPv4 address, Wi-Fi MAC address, independently verified SSH SHA-256 fingerprint and root SSH password. These are stored privately on this Home Assistant, outside the integration package. Saving does not connect, install, restart or change the speaker. Updating a connection requires the same physical identity and a newly entered password.

init.title: Select the initial room backend
init.description: Choose simulation or configure the authenticated endpoint. Simulation remains available for rollback.

endpoint.title: Configure the authenticated endpoint
endpoint.description: Enter endpoint identity and trust-file paths from the disposable Home Assistant lab. This form validates local metadata and files without connecting to the endpoint.

error.invalid_speaker: Check the private IPv4 address, MAC address, verified SSH fingerprint and password.
error.speaker_configuration_failed: The speaker connection could not be saved. Check for a duplicate speaker or an operation in progress, then open Configure again.
error.invalid_endpoint: Check the host, port, UUID, SHA-256 pin, and all three local trust-file paths.
error.invalid_room_name: Enter a room name from 1 to 64 characters without control characters.
